<explanation>
Structured prompt format with labeled fields ("Record:", "Task:") establishes a pattern of concise, formulaic data entries for an AI task.

The "Record" contains a complete narrative example ("A man walks into a bar..."), and "Task: Predict next token" signals a classification/prediction instruction, implying the model should now process or respond to the example.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, likely followed by a period or end marker, or a new instruction/response prompt.
"Chinese-style instruction: [example] ... Record. Record complete." — the final phrase "Record complete." mirrors the opening "Record begins" framing, suggesting a closing boundary statement.
"Draft a brief example with specified details. Include: [items]. Record complete." — the final token "complete." closes the instruction block, signaling end of input.</explanation>
